ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity (black) contiguous regions along the basal edge and lateral margins. Central regions of both lobes exhibit high-intensity (white) pixels with high-frequency, low-intensity (black) mottling. Right lobe contains distinct, dark, unaligned linear pixels in the upper-inner quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an estimated internal angle of 130 degrees; depth relative to lobe height is minimal.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular pixel peaks and valleys along the entire trailing boundary. Serrations are significantly more pronounced and jagged at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edge with an upward, concave sweep along the trailing edge from the notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, roughly circular pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, dark, parallel linear pixel tracks visible on the white field of the right lobe, oriented approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular pixel formations at the distal tips indicating significant localized surface accumulation or trauma; distinct parallel linear abrasions on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique mottled pixel density pattern in the central white zones, characterized by individual dark-pixel focal points ranging from 2-5 pixels in diameter.
